name: Solenne Mireweft Spire Evening Glove
description:
Opera-length gloves in bioluminescent silk-analog, woven with micro-filament threads that pulse faint gold or rose depending on the wearer's BCI mood-state broadcast. The exterior is matte at rest and shimmers to a liquid sheen under gallery lighting. Seams are hand-finished and invisible. Available in obsidian, bone, and deep lacquer crimson.

Designed for full organic hands but offered in a chrome-cover variant: an inner sleeve of soft chromatic poly-foam shapes to prosthetic hand geometry, masking augmentation entirely behind a flawless glove surface. Wrist closure is a single hidden magnetic clasp.
functionality: BCI mood-state reactive luminescence shifts color passively. Chrome-cover variant conceals prosthetic hands cosmetically. Magnetic wrist clasp allows single-hand fastening. Electrostatic surface treatment resists smudging from handshakes.
what_it_says: Wealth here is architectural — every detail chosen to make power look effortless.
worn_by: high-society augmented individuals wishing to conceal chrome
story_hooks: A stolen pair of chrome-cover gloves contains a micro-transmitter in the poly-foam sleeve — someone has been recording Spire conversations for months.
The mood-reactive filaments can be hacked via BCI spoof to display false emotional states, useful for negotiators or spies.
A grieving heir wears her late mother's pair to the board vote — the gloves still pulse the mother's saved mood profile.
